description: GH #37 §G. Bevel depth + resolution; round / object / custom-profile bevel; taper object; extrude (2D fill) + fill mode (none/back/front/half/full) + caps; offset; preview/render U resolution. Turns an authored curve into a swept/filled surface. Depends on curve authoring.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content: src/curve_surface.rs (new, ~330 LOC + 5 tests): curve_to_mesh(spline, CurveGeometry{bevel: Bevel{None|Round{depth,segments}|Profile{section,closed}}, taper: Option<Spline>, fill: FillMode{None|Full}, caps}). Sweeps the cross-section along the spline's parallel-transport frames scaling by depth*radius*taper(t); bridges consecutive rings; fan-caps open ends. No-bevel cyclic + FillMode::Full -> ear-clip triangulation of the outline in its best-fit plane. Verified: round bevel tube r<=0.5, taper shrinks to r<0.1, custom profile = 1 quad/side, closed quad fill = 2 tris chi 1, no-bevel = wire. clippy clean.

title: outram-blender: curve -> surface geometry (bevel depth+profile, taper object, 2D fill/caps/fill-modes)

description:
Extend the melting/solidification coverage in outram-foam-basic-lib beyond the already-ported enthalpy-porosity fvModel (src/fv_options/solidification_melting.rs).

Missing, per survey 2026-08-05:
- porosityModels::solidification (src/finiteVolume/cfdTools/general/porosityModel/solidification/) -- simple temperature-tabulated Darcy blockage, NO latent heat.
- fv::VoFSolidificationMelting (applications/modules/compressibleVoF/fvModels/VoFSolidificationMelting/) -- VoF variant keyed on a solid-fraction-vs-temperature table.
- A buoyant Boussinesq incompressible PIMPLE solver loop in outram-foam-appbuilder-lib that carries a temperature equation and applies fvModels to BOTH the momentum and the energy equation. pimple_foam has neither.
- Gau and Viskanta (1986) gallium melting verification case.
